name: Aeronca 7 Champ
summary: Postwar tandem two-seat fabric taildragger, a popular trainer and the ancestor of the Citabria.

engines: Small flat-four, often with cylinder heads exposed
fuselage: Tandem two-seat cabin with a large, greenhouse-like window area
Deep, rounded forward fuselage tapering sharply to the tail
Tailwheel gear with oleo/spring main legs

tellTales: Deep, rounded forward fuselage with lots of window area on a small tandem taildragger
Fuselage underside sweeps up steeply toward the tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Cub has a slimmer, boxier fuselage with less glazing; the Champ's forward fuselage is deeper and rounder with more windows.
The Citabria has a squared-off tail and squared wingtips; the Champ's tail and tips are rounded.
The Luscombe is all-metal with side-by-side seats; the Champ is fabric-covered with tandem seats.
